entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The current guildmaster of House Dimir on Ravnica, a mindmage and shapeshifter who hides behind a cloak of illusion.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive Ravnican guild led by Lazav.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane on which House Dimir operates.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The previous guildmaster of the Dimir, whose methods Lazav continued.

entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: The Dimir guildhall, rebuilt by Lazav after the old one was lost.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A mercenary who performed thefts for Lazav and the Dimir.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who thwarted Lazav's plan at the Implicit Maze by merging the champions' minds and became the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The invader who took over several guilds and whom Lazav saw as a threat.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Lazav impersonated and assisted during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Artificer whom Lazav assisted and later impersonated.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Ally of Lazav in shutting off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Bolas's servant defeated and blinded by Lazav, later killed on Lazav's order.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact whose shutdown let planeswalkers leave Ravnica.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who led the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon guildmaster resurrected and given the power of the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov leader who partnered with Lazav.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Became the permanent acting guildmaster of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Atkos Tarr
entities.description: Lazav's secret assassin.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Lazav blackmailed.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who partnered with Lazav and defeated Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker defeated by Tezzeret who told the truth that Tezzeret lived.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild Lazav subverted.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild Lazav infiltrated.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: Ghostly Orzhov council from which something was stolen.

entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: The chaotic maze-running event Lazav tried to exploit.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle against Bolas in which Lazav helped disable the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Lazav lay low and was rumored dead.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane on which Lazav later appeared.

events.summary: After Szadek's death, Lazav gathers what remains of the Dimir and has a new Duskmantle built.
events.quote: Lazav managed to gather what was left of the Dimir and bring them together.

events.summary: Lazav attempts to exploit the Implicit Maze to make the maze-runners kill each other; Jace merges the champions' minds and is made the Living Guildpact, thwarting him.
events.quote: His plan to destroy the rival guilds and seize power for the Dimir was thwarted

events.summary: Lazav cleanses his guild of Bolas's agents and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas at the guild summit.
events.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

events.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra to fight Dovin Baan, letting the real Chandra disable the Immortal Sun, then blinds Baan.
events.quote: He disguised himself as Chandra in the fight against Dovin Baan

events.summary: Lazav and the other guildmasters take part in Nissa's ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Lazav participated in a ritual led by Nissa to resurrect Niv-Mizzet

events.summary: After the War of the Spark, Lazav partners with Teysa Karlov to control the Orzhov, has Dovin Baan killed to blackmail Vraska, and partners with Tezzeret.
events.quote: Lazav had Dovin Baan killed, which allowed the shapeshifter to blackmail Vraska

events.summary: Since the New Phyrexian Invasion, Lazav lies low while the guild spreads the lie that he died, secretly assuming the faces of low-rank agents.
events.quote: Many Dimir guild members have spread the lie that he died during the invasion.

events.summary: Lazav appears on Thunder Junction, likely to lay low and run the Dimir from the shadows.
events.quote: Lazav later appeared on Thunder Junction

relations.quote: Lazav is the current guildmaster of House Dimir on Ravnica

relations.note: Saw Bolas as a direct threat and cleansed his agents.
relations.quote: He discovered that Bolas represented a direct threat to House Dimir's existence

relations.note: Formed a partnership over control of the Orzhov.
relations.quote: He formed a partnership with Teysa Karlov
Lazav continued to use most of Szadek's methods

relations.note: Defeated and blinded him, later had him killed.
Krenko is a mercenary working for the Dimir.
relations.quote: Lazav and Krenko performed a few thefts
